info.title: sonde
info.description: Command-line front door to Sonde: launch a process with the probe, then eval C# inside it.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Run C# inside a live .NET process. Start the process with `sonde env` or `sonde run`, then `sonde eval` into it.

commands.name: env
commands.description: Print the environment variables that load the probe into a process you launch yourself.

options.name: --name
options.description: A name for the process; its endpoint is derived from it. Default: the current directory's name.

options.name: --project
options.description: The app's project directory, so its own runtimeconfig.template.json is merged into the one Sonde writes for `dotnet watch`.

options.name: --format
options.description: How to print the variables. [default: shell]

commands.name: run
commands.description: Launch a command with the probe loaded into it, and wait for it to exit.

options.name: --name
options.description: A name for the process; its endpoint is derived from it. Default: the current directory's name.

arguments.name: COMMAND
arguments.description: The command to launch, after `--`: for example `-- dotnet run --project MyApp`.

commands.name: hello
commands.description: Describe the process behind a probe: runtime, pid, loaded assemblies, probe version.

arguments.name: TARGET
arguments.description: A name given to `sonde env`/`sonde run`, or an endpoint (socket path or pipe name).

commands.name: status
commands.description: Report a probe's state: running eval, live contexts, hooks and taps.

arguments.name: TARGET
arguments.description: A name given to `sonde env`/`sonde run`, or an endpoint (socket path or pipe name).

commands.name: eval
commands.description: Compile a script, run it inside the process, print what came back.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Milliseconds to wait for the script. [default: 10000]

options.name: --max-depth
options.description: How deep the result is serialised. [default: 6]

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the whole result (outcome, result, logs, timing) as one JSON object. [default: False]

arguments.name: TARGET
arguments.description: A name given to `sonde env`/`sonde run`, or an endpoint (socket path or pipe name).

arguments.name: SCRIPT
arguments.description: C# statements ending in `return x;`, or `@file.cs`, or `-` to read stdin.

commands.name: ls
commands.description: List the endpoints under the Sonde home directory and whether a probe answers at each.
